summary.en: Kogoro receives a letter containing an invitation to an off-season Halloween party that will happen on the following day, and a mildly sarcastic letter from someone named Vermouth in Latin. Later that day, while Sonoko is trying out makeups on Kogoro so he is ready to join the party and show that Vermouth has underestimated his deductive skills, Ran calls Agasa to ask him if he knows anyone named Vermouth, to which he denies. In addition, Ran also asks him if Shinichi received a similar letter to Kogoro, with Conan hearing the call nearby and holding that same invitation. He asks Agasa to not say anything to Ran. Though the letter Conan received is for him, the letter was sent to the Kudo residence, meaning that the party could potentially be a trap to lure Shinichi Kudo out and silence him. Conan then receives a message texting “OK” from someone that makes him smile, implying that he is ready to confront Vermouth.

locations: A cruise ship, where the "Off-Season Halloween Party" takes place
suspects: Party participants with the Devil's card including Medusa, Mummy, Werewolf, Invisible Man, and Frankenstein
